androgen deprivation did not significantly affect [18F]fluorodeoxyglucose and [11C]-choline uptake in LAPC-3 and LAPC-4 prostate cancer xenografted tumours in nude male mice.
the uptake of 18F-FDG and 11C-choline in prostate cancer xenograt models was decreased after castration, whereas the uptake of 11C-acetate remained unaffected.
the uptake of [F18]FDG, and [C11]choline, but not [C11]acetate, is affected by androgen-deprivation in an in vivo model of prostate cancer.

[18F]choline and especially [11F]FDG PET may miss or underestimate the detection of local recurrent PCA after AD.
